_meta.author: host (Jenny)
_meta.storage: Hub database only; nothing leaves Eden

global_norms: Result first: the point in the first line.
No phone numbers, emails, pay, health or family details, ever.
Client names stay on internal recruiting posts only, never in Partners.
Be kind, be brief, be specific. Warm, never snarky.
The Sabbath is quiet: no posting from Friday sunset to Saturday sunset.

channels.name: Announcements
channels.purpose: Official news from Kev and leadership.
norms: Reactions welcome, threads go to Help.

channels.name: Wins
channels.purpose: Placements, starts, great calls, personal milestones. Celebrate out loud.
norms: Name the win and the person who earned it.
Say what made it work in one line.

channels.name: Help
channels.purpose: Ask a question, get an answer from a teammate or an Eden agent.
norms: Tag it: recruiting, tools, process, other.

channels.name: Recruiting tips
channels.purpose: Scripts, objections, sourcing moves that worked.
norms: Share the move, not the candidate.

channels.name: Reading room
channels.purpose: Books, podcasts and ideas. Leaders are readers.
norms: One line on why it is worth the time.

channels.name: Encouragement
channels.purpose: A place to lift each other up, including prayer requests if you choose to share.
norms: Share only what is yours to share.
No health or family detail about others.
